_comment: W22d (#17-D) error-model golden — variant names + Display prefixes for the 7 pub error types. A variant added/removed/renamed or a Display prefix changed without updating this file = red (contract lock, COMMAND_SURFACE philosophy). Counts recorded as measured (w22d census): ConnectError 5 / CdpError 7 — the W22 design's 9/8 figures were estimates, the measured sets below are the contract.

BrowserError.source_chain: none — all payloads are String; From<io::Error>-style conversions upstream materialize to_string()

ConnectError.source_chain: none — From<io::Error> materializes to_string() into ConnectionFailed (chain-loss finding #w22d-1)

CdpError.source_chain: IoError CARRIES io::Error but the hand-written `impl std::error::Error for CdpError {}` does not override source() — source() returns None (chain-loss finding #w22d-2)

ErrorCode.payload_style: C-style repr(u8) JS-error-kind classifier — not a std::error::Error by design

JsError.shape: struct { message, filename, line, column, stack: Option<String> }
JsError.display: RUNTIME MAIN-ENTRY TYPED ERROR — `{filename}:{line}:{column}: {message}` + optional stack block
JsError.payload_style: structured JS exception (location + stack) — the typed face of NodeRuntime::eval
JsError.source_chain: none — JS exceptions have no lower Rust source by definition (JS-semantics keep-as-fact)

inner_tag_enum.note: bun_core::JsError is the INTERNAL 1-byte tag enum (Thrown/OutOfMemory/Terminated), not the runtime entry contract
